user.title: Zero Grid Controller — Grid Sensors
user.description: Add the sensors that measure how much power is drawn from and delivered to the grid. Add PV arrays and batteries as subentries after setup.

data.name: Integration name
data.grid_import_sensors: Grid import sensors (power drawn from grid)
data.grid_export_sensors: Grid export sensors (power delivered to grid, optional)

data_description.deadband_w: Grid swings within ±this value are ignored. Prevents constant micro-adjustments when already close to zero. Start with 20 W.
data_description.ewm_alpha: How quickly the controller reacts to grid changes. Lower = smoother but slower (0.1), higher = faster but jumpier (0.5). Default 0.3 suits most systems.
data_description.aggressiveness: How fast the controller responds after calibration. Cautious = stable, slow. Normal = balanced. Fast = quick, may overshoot.

error.no_sensors: At least one import or export sensor is required.
error.duplicate_name: This name is already in use.

abort.already_configured: Zero Grid Controller is already configured.

user.title: Add PV array
user.description: Choose an array name and output type.

reconfigure.title: Configure PV array
reconfigure.description: Update array name and output type.

numeric_params.title: Numeric setpoint parameters
numeric_params.description: Set the entity and range for this array's power limit.

data.setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the power limit

data_description.power_sensor_entity: Per-array power sensor used to measure inverter response during calibration and to detect cloud shadow.
data_description.setpoint_min: The lowest value the controller will ever write (e.g. 0 % or 0 W).
data_description.setpoint_max: The highest value — full output. Calibration uses this range to measure inverter gain.

switch_params.title: Switch control parameters
switch_params.description: Configure the grid power thresholds for turning this switch on and off.

data_description.switch_on_threshold_w: The switch turns on when grid import exceeds this value.
data_description.switch_off_threshold_w: The switch turns off when grid export exceeds this value.
data_description.switch_debounce_s: Minimum seconds between state changes to prevent rapid toggling.

error.min_gte_max: Minimum setpoint must be less than maximum.
error.off_gte_on: Turn-off threshold must be less than turn-on threshold.
error.duplicate_name: This array name is already in use.

data_description.battery_sensor: Sign convention: negative = charging, positive = discharging.
data_description.battery_setpoint_entity: The number entity the controller writes to set the battery target power (negative = charge, positive = discharge).

data_description.battery_sensor: Sign convention: negative = charging, positive = discharging.
data_description.battery_setpoint_entity: The number entity the controller writes to set the battery target power (negative = charge, positive = discharge).

error.duplicate_name: This battery name is already in use.

user.title: Add controllable load
user.description: Choose a name and type for this load.

reconfigure.title: Configure controllable load
reconfigure.description: Update name and type for this load.

numeric_params.title: Numeric load parameters
numeric_params.description: Configure the setpoint entity and power characteristics.

data_description.setpoint_entity: The number entity the controller writes to adjust load power.
data_description.w_per_unit: Power change per unit step. For an EV charger: 230 W/A (single-phase 230 V) or 690 W/A (three-phase 400 V). For a boiler or other load: measure it or check the manual.
data_description.absolute_min_w: Minimum power when on. Some EV chargers require at least 6 A (1380 W single-phase) and cannot run below this. Set to that minimum, or leave at 0 if your device can go all the way down to zero.
data_description.settling_time_s: Seconds to wait after changing the setpoint before adjusting again. Most EV chargers and inverters need 10–30 s to stabilise.
data_description.power_sensor_entity: Optional sensor measuring actual load power for monitoring.
data_description.load_priority: Lower number = higher priority. The highest-priority load absorbs surplus first and is the last to be reduced.

switch_params.title: Switch load parameters
switch_params.description: Configure the fixed power and debounce time.

data_description.setpoint_entity: The switch or input_boolean entity to toggle.
data_description.load_power_w: Power consumption when the load is on. Used to decide when there is enough surplus to turn it on.

error.min_gte_max: Minimum setpoint must be less than maximum.
error.duplicate_name: This load name is already in use.

grid_sensor_unavailable.title: Grid sensor unavailable
grid_sensor_unavailable.description: The configured grid power sensor(s) are unavailable. Zero Grid Controller cannot measure grid power and has entered safe state. Check that your grid sensors are online and reporting valid states.

reset_pid.name: Reset PID
reset_pid.description: Reset the PID integrator and derivative history.

recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
recalibrate.description: Re-run automatic step-response calibration for one or all arrays.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID to recalibrate. Leave empty to recalibrate the loaded instance.
